blocks.text: These files were migrated from the former `/Users/richardtang/Documents/Proofpress` checkout, which is no longer maintained. They preserve the STALE/CUPMem condition contract, exploratory preregistration, and observed dataset profile. The source data hash and upstream commit were reverified in `upstream_lock.json`; the two-record pilot and official scorer run are recorded in `pilot_report.json`. The pre-registered stop/narrow gate fired, so no held-out confirmatory matrix was run.

The former two-arm local Codex pilot was intentionally not migrated as an executable runner. The current `run_pilot.py` is the exploratory adapter used for S0–S3; its CUPMem S1/S3 results use independent per-query checkpoints because the full-record adapter exceeded local memory limits. Those adapter limitations keep the result narrow and non-confirmatory.
